query:
UPDATE tasks
                SET 
                    title = $1,
                    description = $2,
                    priority = $3,
                    status_id = $4,
                    position = (
                        SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), -1) + 1
                        FROM tasks
                        WHERE status_id = $4
                    ), tags = $5
                WHERE id = $6
                RETURNING position AS "position!"
